Audio companion · ICASSP 2027 submission

Auditing and Steering Arousal Trajectories in Text-to-Music Generation

Every clip on this page is one the paper reports on, unedited apart from trimming and level-matching. Scores are the paper's listener-validated arousal proxy on a 1–9 scale, with human reference music scored out-of-fold on the same footing; listener numbers are means from the 24-person blinded study. Headphones recommended.

Six of the 840 stable-audio-3-medium generations (20-s excerpts). The first four sit near their category means; the last two are the typical and the single most intense of the 120 high-arousal generations. §4.3 · Listening study, blinded

Hear what the listeners heard, before you see the labels

Each set is one initial arousal state rendered by the three planners the study compared: direct-to-calm (jump), the ISO schedule (rule), and the schedule with best-of-4 selection under the proxy (rule+BoN). Order is shuffled. Listen, form a view, then reveal the planner, its proxy trajectory against the cosine schedule, and the study's mean ratings for that exact clip.

Across all 24 listeners and 8 initial states (7-point scales, jump / rule / rule+BoN): endpoint calmness ; transition smoothness ; start match ; overall trajectory . Scheduled planners are heard to match the stated start better; listeners prefer jump on everything else.

§4.2 · The audited model as action space

The same objective steering stable-audio-3-medium

One episode (stated start ): five 6-s segments whose prompts verbalise the scheduled level. prompted takes the first candidate per segment; schedule+BoN picks, among four candidates, the one whose proxy arousal is closest to the schedule; jump uses calm-level candidates throughout. Blinded like the sets above.

§4.3 · Proxy versus ears

Single clips: what the proxy says, what 24 listeners said

Eight of the calibration clips (synthesiser segments and stable-audio-3 generations; the DEAM excerpts are not redistributed here). Item-level Spearman ρ between proxy and perceived arousal: synthesiser , generations , real music . Note the proxy's compression at the top of the synthesiser scale.

Generation: stable-audio-3-medium via stable-audio-tools 0.0.20, 8-step ping-pong sampler, cfg 1.0, fp16, per-clip seeds recorded; MusicGen-small replication and decoding sweep are in the paper. Synthesiser: fluidsynth with FluidR3_GM. Listener ratings: 24 participants, within-subject, blinded; 857 of 864 trajectory ratings valid. Clips are level-matched to −0.9 dBFS peak for playback only; all reported scores were computed on the original audio.
